notes.title: September update
notes.notes:
During testing the game I realized that a key ARPG component was almost completely missing from the game - itemization. Items and curse stones were generated as loot but their stats were not randomized beyond few number rolls, such as damage or armor amount. This lead to the situation where when a loot item dropped, you could immediately tell if it was relevant for your build or not, without even seeing the affixes or stats of the item. 



So after realizing this, I reworked the loot drop & item randomization mechanics, and it's a lot better now - each item & curse stone has a broad set of affixes that it rolls it's stats from, depending on the item type and initial "item quality" roll.



I also added improved lighting of the levels as well as adding random loot chests, but these aren't quite right yet so I'll have to keep developing them. 


For the playtest, it seems like whenever I finish a core feature, I realized that another one is missing. This just means that the scope needed to test an ARPG game is huge, as there are so many already established features that this genre of game needs.

notes.title: August update
notes.notes:
Summer vacation is over, and while I was unable to get a test build done there was major progress regardless. Pathfinding, enemy AI, and level generation all had major issues, so I ended up re-writing each of those systems. While they still aren't perfect, they should be good enough for the test build which I I'm working on next. Other updates were damage effects, new enemy skills, like buffs and summoning creatures, and the coolest new feature is projectile redirection: projectiles can collider mid-air and the player can also deflect projectiles with melee attacks.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651676/14cebe493d8fd7dae8d5c30e5af73ebf338f2062.gif"]

Projectiles that collide now redirect depending on their piercing stats - the stronger projectile keeps going while the other is redirected

notes.title: July update - Akimbo
notes.notes:
After a busy June there's loads of features done, first of which was the "pistols akimbo" feature that allows you to dual wield firearms. The UI wireframe is also done but the details and graphics are still work in progress. Level generation along with the first level (including the first boss) is also almost done. 



The demo launch is still months away, but hopefully initial playtesting can begin this month. The priority is now to finish the first playtest scope along basic quality of life features like settings and menus.
